sentences.text:
1. Heard.
2.

The applicant has preferred this second bail application under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 264 of 2021 registered at Police Station Darri, Distt. Korba, Chhattisgarh (C.G) for the offence punishable under Sections 420 read with Section 34 of IPC.
3.

entities.text: Police Station Darri, Distt. Korba, Chhattisgarh
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per the prosecution case, on a report being made by one Mahendra Kumar Sahu from Korba that from his account, the amounts were withdrawn at different points of time, the investigation was carried out.
During the course of investigation, it reveals that he received phone calls from Prime Minister PMGEP Scheme which provides for grant of different loans.

It is alleged that Pawan Kumar, Jaikishan, Anil, Vijay Kumar, Nitin Sinha, Rahul Verma used to call different beneficiaries for providing loans and used to ask the different beneficiaries to deposit money.
Consequently, over ma period of time, Rs.97,29,256/- was deposited in between 15.09.2020 to 01.10.2020.
Eventually the loan was not granted.

Subsequently on an investigation report being made, it was revealed that Vijay Kumar is the owner of a mobile shop who used to provide forged SIMS inasmuch as different beneficiaries used to come to his shop and thereby he used the copy of SIM, Mobile etc.

Thereafter,
he calls different beneficiaries and used to cheat them.

sentences.text: The allegation against the present applicant is that the beneficiaries who used to come for preparation of ATM and other cards, he being the owner of mobile shop used to sell them for Rs.25,000/- & odd and in consequence thereof, he along with others used to call the people at different places in India and one of such call was made to the complainant who has deposited the amount.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
He would further submit that the applicant is in detention since 28-12-2021 and the conclusion of trial will take more time.
Thus, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
6. Learned counsel for the State, per contra, would oppose the bail application and would submit that out of 14 witnesses 7 witnesses have already been examined.

7. Considering the entire facts situation of the case; particularly looking to the nature of allegation and also considering the fact that no considerable delay occurred in trial, at this stage, I am of the opinion that present is not a fit case to release the applicant on bail, as no fresh circumstance has come to fore to reconsider the same again on merits.
8. Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
However, the Court below is directed to expedite the trail within a period of three months.
